angle_en: Jnanagamyam: the known and the knower are one
angle_hi: ज्ञानगम्यम्: ज्ञाता और ज्ञेय एक ही हैं

en.intro: Krishna sets the scene by describing the ultimate reality as the source of all light.
en.notice: The word jnanagamyam means reached through knowledge, and here it is knowledge itself. The knower and the known are one and the same.
en.next: Krishna then briefly summarizes the field, knowledge, and the knowable before telling his devotee about attaining his state.
en.meaning: It is the light of all lights, beyond darkness. It is knowledge, the knowable, reached through knowledge, and abiding in every heart.

hi.intro: कृष्ण इस सर्वोच्च सत्य को सभी प्रकाश का स्रोत बताते हैं, जो अज्ञान से परे है और सबके हृदय में विराजमान है।
hi.meaning: वह परमात्मा सम्पूर्ण ज्योतियोंका भी ज्योति और अज्ञानसे अत्यन्त परे कहा गया है। वह ज्ञानस्वरूप, जाननेयोग्य, ज्ञानसाधनसमुदाय से प्राप्त करनेयोग्य और सबके हृदयमें विराजमान है।
hi.notice: ज्ञानगम्यम् का अर्थ है ज्ञान से प्राप्त होने योग्य, और यहाँ यह स्वयं ज्ञान है। ज्ञाता और ज्ञेय एक ही हैं।
hi.next: इस ज्ञान को समझकर भक्त परमेश्वर की स्थिति को प्राप्त करता है।

en.intro: Krishna sets the scene by describing the ultimate reality as the source of all light.
en.body: It is the light of all lights, beyond darkness. It is knowledge, the knowable, reached through knowledge, and abiding in every heart. The word jnanagamyam means reached through knowledge, and here it is knowledge itself. The knower and the known are one and the same. Krishna then briefly summarizes the field, knowledge, and the knowable before telling his devotee about attaining his state.

issues: borrowed: "कृष्ण क्षेत्र, ज्ञान और ज्ञेय का संक्षेप में वर्णन करते हैं और फिर कहते हैं कि इसे समझने से भक्त उनकी अवस्था को प्राप्त होता है।" (The Hindi 'next' presents a summary of verse 19 ('Thus, field, knowledge, and the knowable have been explained briefly...
